component: Phase 6 simulator design (06-01-PLAN entry semantics; skipped 06-REVIEW CR-04)
summary: Backtest fills, invalidates and exits a plan inside the same bar that generated its signal (look-ahead); plans are never carried to later bars; the skipped fix CR-04 was never scheduled
expected: A plan created at the close of bar N fills only from bar N+1 until expiry (trade-through). The position is carried across bars until SL/TP/expiry. The intrabar walk starts after the fill. TP ladder semantics match live.
actual: _resolve_entry(bar=bar) uses the signal bar's own range and its close-vs-open. The exit uses the 1m candles of that same bar (intrabar key = bar.close_time_utc). A trade with no SL/TP hit exits EOD at that bar's end. Missing 1m data gives an unconditional SL exit. TP2 is not modeled. open_positions and daily_loss are constants.
impact: All Phase-6 experiment evidence is structurally invalid: look-ahead in both directions and a 0-bar holding period. The kill gate and V1 family selection would rest on meaningless evidence.
evidence: simulator.py L753-866: the loop passes the signal bar to _resolve_entry (L449 zone touch, L394 invalidation) and uses intrabar_map key f'{bar.symbol}|{bar.close_time_utc}' (L852). 06-REVIEW-FIX L285-298: 'plans are never carried across bars'. Probe on fixture intrabar_both_touched: entry_time 2026-09-11T09:59:59Z, exit_time 2026-09-11T09:00:59Z (the exit happens 59 min before the entry).
why_tests_miss: Golden fixtures pin the current semantics. The determinism suites cover the strategy path, not the simulator fill/exit path. 06-VERIFICATION IN-02b notes the no-lookahead exit is decided on candle 0.
recommendation: DECISIONS row plus protocol v2.0.0: a cross-bar plan lifecycle (active from the next bar, entry checked per bar until expiry, position carried to SL/TP/expiry, TP ladder). Use the fallback only for ambiguous bars. Assert entry_time > detected_at and exit_time >= entry_time. Regenerate the fixtures.
known_prior: Partial. KNOWN:06-REVIEW CR-04 (skipped), 06-VERIFICATION G3, 06-REVIEW WR-02/WR-12. The look-ahead aspect is new.

component: 04-03 checkpoint option A (zone-mid entry_ref) as mapped into the Phase 6 simulator
summary: Backtest counts any touch of the entry zone (even the far edge) as a fill at the zone mid, a price the bar may never have traded
expected: Fill only where the live LIMIT (at the zone mid) would fill: a trade-through of the mid by >= 1 tick. The fill price is the limit.
actual: zone_touched = high >= entry_min and low <= entry_max, then ENTRY_FILLED at entry_ref = (entry_min + entry_max) / 2
impact: A systematic optimistic bias in fill rate and entry price (hidden adverse selection). It persists after F-901 is fixed.
evidence: simulator.py L449 zone_touched; L478-483 '# Zone touched - fill at entry_ref (zone mid)'; L517 entry_price=entry_ref. placement.py L133-143: the live limit is the zone mid. 04-RESEARCH L319 offered 'zone mid or worst-fill edge'. 04-03-SUMMARY L76-80: auto-selected option A.
reproduction: A LONG bar with entry_mid < low <= entry_max makes _resolve_entry return ENTRY_FILLED at the mid
why_tests_miss: The fixtures were generated from the implementation. No test ties the fill rule to the live order price.
recommendation: Derive the simulated fill condition from the live order price (mid) with a trade-through of >= 1 tick. Record edge touches as TOUCH_NO_FILL. Keep option A for live.
known_prior: Stage A F-004 / Corrected Rule 18 (generic). This plan makes it worse.

component: 01-RESEARCH Don't Hand-Roll + Pitfall 2 -> RESEARCH_PROTOCOL numeric-gate reservation
summary: Phase-1 research framed pre-registered numeric acceptance thresholds as an overfitting anti-pattern. This is the planning origin of F-022.
expected: Acceptance thresholds, the trial-count penalty and the holdout protocol are frozen before any Validation run (Corrected Rule 31). Only parameter values are left to research.
actual: 'Numeric gates before data are overfitting commitments'. Protocol L24 reserves every numeric threshold as TBD, including cost assumptions and split ratios. L211: thresholds are proposed only after Validation evidence.
impact: Maximal researcher degrees of freedom at the gate before live money. Phase 10 inherits 'passing = human decision'.
evidence: 01-RESEARCH L226 table row 'Acceptance numbers | Invented thresholds ... | Numeric gates before data are overfitting commitments'; RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md L24, L205-213
recommendation: Protocol v1.1.0 with frozen numeric gates before the first Validation run. A DECISIONS row that reverses the 01-RESEARCH rationale.
known_prior: Stage A F-022 (doc level). The planning origin is new.

summary: Bootstrap depth drifted to 7d (1m) / 30d (1H/4H) instead of the decided 6-12 months / 2 years. 30 days of 4H (180 bars) cannot warm the required EMA200-4H, and no CLI exposes a deeper window.
expected: Defaults match D-02 (>= warm-up + split length), or the deviation is recorded. A CLI with an explicit depth.
actual: DEFAULT_BACKFILL_WINDOWS_MS is 1m 7d, 1h/4h 30d. features_valid requires ema_200. backfill_universe has no CLI caller.
impact: A default bootstrap gives a WARMUP_INSUFFICIENT 4H context on every bar (all NO_TRADE) and almost no 1m coverage (all-SL fallback)
evidence: 02-CONTEXT D-02; backfill.py L551-560; features.py L417-428; strategy.py L113; 30*6 = 180 < 200
reproduction: Arithmetic: 30 d x 6 bars/d = 180 < EMA period 200
why_tests_miss: Tests use recorded pages and fixtures. The real bootstrap was never executed.
recommendation: Align the defaults with D-02, add a CLI with --start/--days, and make the coverage check assert warm-up sufficiency
known_prior: Partial: v0.3 tech_debt 'live-network bootstrap never executed', M4. The depth drift is new.

summary: The correlated cluster is hard-coded to {BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP} and excludes BNB, against the research's own 'registry param' mitigation. The caps count filled positions only.
expected: All live-5 symbols form one cluster per direction. Open risk = filled + working entries + approved-but-unplaced plans, under one lock (Corrected Rule 9).
actual: CLUSTER_SYMBOLS excludes BNBUSDT. A BNB candidate skips the cluster sum (L319-328). 05-02-PLAN: 'counting open positions only'.
impact: Aligned correlated exposure of up to 2x the cluster budget via BNB. Resting 4h entries and pending approvals can together exceed the caps (the 1% aggregate cap still bounds the total).
evidence: portfolio.py L29-31, L319-328; 05-CONTEXT D-03; 05-RESEARCH L310 A3; 05-02-PLAN L69
reproduction: check_portfolio with open BTCUSDT LONG 0.5% + candidate BNBUSDT LONG 0.5% gives no CLUSTER_CAP_REJECT
why_tests_miss: The fixtures encode the chosen membership. There is no working-entry test.
recommendation: A registry-held, hashed cluster list including BNB. A ledger including working entries and approved plans. B2/Stage C should verify the callers.
known_prior: Stage A F-014 (ambiguity). The independent wrong choice is new.
